subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to confirm your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight from New York City to Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport is scheduled for [Date & Time]. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. We have also attached your e-ticket for reference. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, [Airline Name]
